english.title: Fail to comply / prevent compliance with requirement / direction under Psychoactive Substances Act 2016
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[failed, without reasonable excuse, to comply]_
(B)_[prevented **(..SPECIFY PERSON PREVENTED..) from complying]_

with a requirement reasonably made, or a direction reasonably given, namely **(..SPECIFY THE REQUIREMENT MADE / DIRECTION GIVEN..), by **(..SPECIFY NAME..), a relevant enforcement officer in the exercise of a power conferred by sections 36 to 45 of the Psychoactive Substances Act 2016
english.legislation: Contrary to section 48(2) and (4) of the Psychoactive Substances Act 2016.

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: 51 weeks imprisonment and / or a fine

Note: If the offence was committed before the commencement of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003 '51 weeks' is to be read as 'Six months'.

Time Limit for Prosecution:
6 months
